subject: Aging dampens the nighttime cerebrospinal fluid waves that wash the brain
script: From Agewell Brief: Aging dampens the nighttime cerebrospinal fluid waves that wash the brain. MIT researchers discovered that deep-sleep brain waves and vascular responses weaken with age, reducing the nocturnal fluid movements that clear cellular waste from the brain. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
